purpose.objective: Consolidate academy-practice context and memory/history entrypoints with typed hierarchy and topology; reconcile conflicts and bottlenecks and design shared execution contracts while preserving current source owners.
successCriteria: Provide a source-attributed metadata inventory, explicit coverage limits and stable IDs for findings and bounded improvements.
Provide a context selector with date, class and student as its default selection axes, retaining unknown, conflicting, partial and stale states.
Map teaching and student-management workflows to existing repositories and common execution-contract primitives without creating a second native runtime or Memory implementation.
Verify the integrated source change and distinguish local source validation, shared delivery, native activation and user acceptance.
inScope: Metadata-only source inventory and context entrypoint consolidation.
Hierarchy, topology, type and ownership mapping across authorized academy-related sources.
Conflict, duplication, currentness and bottleneck analysis with stable ACX finding IDs.
Common teaching and student-management execution-contract and repository-plan design.
Bounded reversible source improvements and independent source verification.
outOfScope: Migration or rewriting of existing domain records, archives, native sessions, historical effects or source ownership.
Reading real student/business record bodies or credentials for this metadata catalog.
Academy server writes, printing, sending, deployment, authentication changes, native registration or activation.
Research/development or Ontology/Wiki role takeover from the Hermes default-profile Lead.
